title: Yellow Smoky Saudi Arabian Eggplant Skewers
description: A smoky and crunchy lacto-vegetarian friendly dish from Saudi Arabia, featuring chili powder and a deglaze fond, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the eggplant cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the eggplant cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
In a small bowl, whisk together yogurt and lemon juice.
After grilling the skewers, brush them with the yogurt mixture.
Return the skewers to the grill for an additional 2 minutes, until slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional yogurt sauce if desired.
